tei:div.tei:p: (1)༄/ rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gling pa'i rnam thar gyi cha shas la brten nas snyan ngag me long ma'i rgyan gyis bsngags pa bzhugs so/// / (2)

gau ḍā pa'i sbyar ba'i yon tan/ legs legs yon tan legs dgu la// rol ba'i dpal gyis lam ston pas// ma lus mi lus lus pa med// bde legs legs pa'i dpyid du gyur// bhai dar+bha'i lugs/ shes bya kun mkhyen thugs rje'i gter// rdo rje gzi brjid sgyu 'phrul gar// rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa zhes// sa yi khyon na mtshungs pa bral// lho pa'i rab dwangs/ khyod kyi sku gsung thugs mchog ni// snyigs ma'i smag la 'char ba gang*// zla ba'i mtshan pa ut+pal gyis// 'od kyis mdzes pa rgyas dang mtshungs/ / shar pa/ gang gi mdzes snyan zab pa'i phul// dwangs gsal min par 'jug pa ni// shin tu dkar min chu skyes des// mdzes 'od can dang dbye ba ci// lho pa'i mnyam nyid/ shes bya'i chos tshul (3)ma lus pa// thugs kyi dpal ber ye nas rdzogs// ma bslab thams cad mkhyen pa ni// rgya bod gnyis na khyod las su/ / shar pas/ mtsho las byung ba'i pad+ma'i rigs// rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lung bstan bzhin// 'phying dbar bang so'i lho ngos 'gram// 'phyongs rgyas ri brag bcas pa'i grong*/ / gzhan yang*/ ston pa'i gcung po mdzes dga' bo// a dkar dga' rab dpa' bo dang*// kṛ sras dri med khri srong sras// skye ba'i phreng ba bcu gsum pa// snyan pa la lho pa'i tshig mtshungs nye ba'i lam/ kun mkhyen klong chen 'khrungs pa'i gnas// g.yo ru grwa yi phu stod grong*// zar po za ra tshags kyi zer// rgya yags rgyas pa'i khang khyim du// rkang pa la bskor ba'i rjes khrid/ zhi ba sa mo bya yi lo'i// zla ba rgyas la rtsen pa'i dus// (4)rgyal ba'i dbang po dri med 'od// zhi ba chen por mnal ba'i tshes// tshig la bskor ba/ mtha' gnyis ma lhung dam chos lhur len pa'i// rigs su skyes shing sngon gyi rigs sad pas// dpal ldan par+pa ta yi gling du phebs// ngur smrig la dgyes ngur smrig rgyal mtshan bzhes/

gzhan yang ring bar bskor ba/ sngon nas legs par byas pa'i bag chags rgyus// rgyal dbang pad+ma'i mtshan tsam thos na yang*// dad pa'i spu long rab tu rgyas pa dang*// snga 'gyur ba la spro ba'i mngon rtogs ngoms// shar pa kho nas/ bkres pas sbrebs kyis sbrang rtsi dga' ba bzhin// khrims ldan gral du grib tshod legs gzhal nas// blo gros mchog gi dge ba'i tshul bzang po// yon tan rgya mtsho'i gzhi ma legs par mnos// spang bya grong pa'i tshig dus kyi dbang las 'dus pa'i sder// chang dang bud med la bsten pa'i// sdig pa'i grogs ni med na yang*// byis pa'i skyon gyis gos pa med// spang byed kyi nyams/ dus kyi tha mar chos kyi 'dun pa cher// yid srub gdon gyis rang dbang bral ba'i sems// rkang pa gnyis kyi khyogs la brten mang (5)yang*// 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyi dris ma gos/ grong tshig mtshams sbyor la song ba/ grogs kyis dben pa'i bya skyibs su// de na tshod ma rnying pa la// rtag par rgyun du longs spyod pa'i// dge sbyong 'di dag dben la dga'// dge la sbyor ba'i skye bo phal// lha bya lce gnyis brtul zhugs kyis/ mchan bu lha bya lce gnyis zer ba ne tso la go chos mthun grogs kyang so sor 'byed// mthun gnyis bar dbyen byed pa yin/ lha bya lce gnyis zer dus bud med kyi mo mtshan la go bas/ bud med ma dum nas 'dzing ba yin/ /de 'dra'i rjes su slob pa med// ngag don gyi grong tshig / bsod nams ldan pa'i dga' ster mchog pad+ma'i myu gu bde ba che// yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// ba spu dag kyang kun nas g.yo// dmigs bsal skyon med/ pad+ma'i rgyal tshab thugs mchog rdo rje las// man ngag nor bu lta bu'i chos bcu gsum// mngon par dga' ba'i dad pas nyer blangs nas// rim pa gnyis kyis 'dod pa'i don kun sgrub// lho pa'i shin gzhon/

nags tshal bsil grib me tog skyed mos tshal// yan lag brgyad ldan chu klung (6)dal gyis 'bab// dben pa'i yon tan phun tshogs nyams dga' ba// 'jigs pa bral ba'i skyes bu gnas der rgyu// shar pas/ bgrang bya bdun phrag bar du them mi brgal// mjal phrad gtam mi sgrogs dang chos mi btsong*// chos spyod sgrub dang dkor zas byung rgyal min// grol ba las gzhan mi sgrub dam bca' bdun// don gsal/ klong chen mkhas pas bgrang bya drug gi bar// re ldai'i snod kyis gos dang stan byas nas// dngul chu ril bu'i zas kyi dka' thub kyis// grub pa'i sa mthor gshegs pa'ang bdag gir bzhes// shar pa kha gcig pas/ bsgo ba mal stan tha dad min// phra ba'i zas kyi dka' thub kyis// 'phags pa'i lam la bsgrod pa yi// dam pa'i rnam par thar la 'gran// lho pa'i rgya che/ dri med 'od kyi ye shes sku yi zhal// lan gsum bltas pa'i mod la chos rnams kyi// ji lta ji snyed blo gros mthu thob pas// bshes gnyen gzhan gyi zhal la blta ma yin// gau ḍā pa/ /mdzod chen bdun dang yang tig rnam pa gsum// tshig dang don gyi brgyud pa rdzogs pa dang*/ glegs bam sbyin zhing sku gsung thugs mchog gi /byin gyis rlabs pas dgongs pa'i gding chen rnyed// shar pa'i brjid pa/ 'gyur ba ma gos la bzla ba// rang (7)byung rig pa 'gyur med rtogs// bhai dar+bhas/ ma bcos ma bslad ka dag pa// 'gyur ba med pa chos sku yin// lho pa'i mdzes pa'i gtam/ kun mkhyen blo ldan khyod 'dra yi// zhabs sen yal 'dab gtsang ma'i rdul// yan lag mchog la reg pa gang*// tshangs pa'i gnas zhes don ldan byas// bsngags pa/ bsil ldan ra ba dkar po'i ljongs 'di ru// rab 'byams gsung rab kun la blta ba'i mig /rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros mtha' yas pa// khyod kyis dpyad pa'i go skabs rnyed ma yin// gau ḍā ba'i gtam/ deng nas bzung ste bdag gi lus// brgya byin la yang 'gran par nus//

khyod kyi zhabs rdul reg pa yis// nyes pa'i dri ma thams cad bkrus// bsngags pa/ khyod kyi blo gros 'di lta bu// mtha' yas rab tu rgyas pa 'di// nges par ma brtags lo tsā bas// gsung rab bsgyur ba nyung ngur song*// ting 'dzin spyi/ khyod kyi zhal gyi 'od zer gyis// log par rtog rnams kha zum nas// legs par 'byor rnams kha 'byed bzhin// ge sar ze'u 'bru rab tu bzhad// chos gcig la bkod pa/ slob mas legs bshad skyugs pa rnams// 'thung nas slar yang skyugs par byed// kha yis dag byed gaṅgā'i rgyun// shin tu (8)skyugs par byed pa bzhin// chos du ma/ gzhon nu'i lang tshos rab spras shing*// mdzes pas brgyan pa'i rkang drug dag mdza' bo'i dbang po'i sgo la 'khyud// rtse dgas glu dbyangs snyan par sgrogs/ /lam rnam par dbye ba'i sarga dang po'o// / don rgyan so lnga'i nang gses rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan las/ rigs rang bzhin brjod pa ni/ snying rje che zhing rig pa hur// thugs sgam tshig btsan blo gros zab// 'jigs pa med pa'i brtul zhugs can// rtogs grol dus mnyam thugs gter bdag / bya ba/ gcig pur sgrub la brtson 'grus bskyed// 'brel tshad rnam grol sa la sbyar// zab rgyas chos tshul ma lus pa// zab rgu'i bcud du dril nas bzhag / yon tan/ ye shes bla ma'i yon tan 'di// thogs med rmongs pa sel ba dang*// rtogs pa'i gdeng chen thob pa rnams// snang bzhi zad pa'i klong du 'jug / rdzas/ mthon mthing ral pa'i glegs bam nas// 'jigs bral ras dkar bla gos can// rkang chen dung dang ḍā ma ru// rdo rje dril bu gsal bar gyur// gnyis pa dpe rgyan la/ chos dpe ni/ thub dbang khyod kyi mgrin pa yi// glu yi dkor mdzod rdol ba ni// sgra dbyangs lha mo'i rgyud mang bzhin// (9)/snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i phul du byung*// dngos po'i dpe/ mgon po khyod kyi zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ni// bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas ston zla gsar pa bzhin// 'od dang 'od zer kun tu rgyas pa ni// dbang po'i mtshon cha'i rjes su rnam par phyogs//

zlog pa'i dpe/ khyod bzhin 'jam dpal dbyangs ni mkhyen rab bkra// khyod bzhin spyan ras gzigs dbang snying rje can// khyod bzhin rdo rje 'dzin dbang mthu stobs che// khyod bzhin dbyangs can ma ni ngag gi dbang*// phan tshun dpe/ khyod kyi thugs rje'i 'dzum zer ni// mig mi 'dzum pa nyid dang mtshungs// gru 'dzin bdag pos brtse ba'i spyan// nges par khyod kyi brtse la 'gran// nges pa'i dpe/ khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyis// rigs gsum mgon po'i skal bzang phrogs// dpe zlar 'os pa gzhan 'ga' zhig /'jig rten gsum na srid pa min// ma nges pa'i dpe/ re zhig mgon po mchog nyid kyis// rdo rje rnon po yang dag mjal// gzhan yang khyod mtshungs res 'ga' zhig gal te srid na de rjes phyogs// bsdus pa'i dpe/ (10)khyod kyi bstan bcos snyan pa kho na yis// tshangs sras lha mo'i dbyangs la 'gran min te// yid kyi 'gyur ba rab tu bskyed pa dang*// bde ba'i dpal gyi 'byor pa sbyin pas kyang*/ khyad par gyi dpe/ khyod kyi dbyangs ni khyod kyi mgrin pa la// mthong gi rgyud mang dri za'i lag na snang*// 'di nyid kho nas tha dad dbye ba las// gzhan du dbye ba'i rgyu ni dmigs su med// rab brtags kyi dpe/ rgyal sras de yis tshangs pa'i dbyangs// nga nyid la ni yod do zhes// pi waṃ khyod rang snyems mi dgos// rdza rnga la yang de yod phyir// rmad byung dpe/ gal te rgyud mang 'ga' zhig gis// blang dor lam ni ston pa dang*// bstan pa'i rgyun ni 'dzin nus na// khyed kyi gsung dang cis mi mtshungs/ rmongs pa'i dpe/ blo ldan khyod gsung tam+bu ra// zhes btags khyod gsung dran dran pas// rgyud mang sbrengs bar thos pa na// khyod gsung yin snyam dran pa skyes// the tshom dpe/ mkhas pa khyod kyis mgrin glu rdol ba'am// ngang pa'i bu mos rgyud ldan bsgrags pa'am// legs par 'byed (11)pa'i rjes dpag ma ldan pas// bdag gi sems ni nem nur can du gyur//

gtan 'bebs dpe/ khyod kyi tshangs dbyangs 'di lta bu// dri za'i lag gi sgra yis ni// 'phral yun phan bde sgrub mi nus// de phyir legs par bshad pa nyid// sbyar ba'i dpe/ shes bya kun mkhyen 'gro la rjes su brtse// theg chen lam ston mtha' yas sems can don// snying stobs chen po'i brtson pa lhur len pa'i// 'jigs med gling khyod 'jam dpal dbyangs dang mtshungs// mnyam nyid dpe/ blo gter khyod ni chu yi bzhon pa bzhin// skal ldan shing rta'i dpal las legs thob cing*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa de dbang chus// yid can bde ba'i sems pa sbyin mdzad dpal// smad pa'i dpe/ ngang pa'i shing rta snyems dang bcas// mchod sbyin brgya pa 'dod pas g.yeng*// de dag las kyang khyod kyi thugs// mtshungs pa las kyang khyad par bcas// bsngags pa'i dpe/ pad+ma sangs rgyas gnyis pa 'khrungs pa'i gnas// zla ba 'khor lo sdom pa'i gtsug na mdzes// de dag kun dang mgon po khyod kyi zhal// mtshungs pa las kyang shin tu lhag par mdzes// brjod 'dod dpe/ kun gsal pha mtha' (12)bral ba'i yon tan nam// gal te skyon gyi rnam pa mchis kyang rung*// khyod thugs 'chi med lam dang 'gran no zhes// brjod 'dod blo ni bdag gi snying la nyal// 'gal ba'i dpe/ 'chi med lam chen phyogs dus khyab pa dang*// rin chen 'byung gnas gting dpag dka' ba dang*// khyod kyi mkhyen pa zab cing rgyas pa gsum// phan tshun rnam pa kun tu 'gal bar byed// dgag pa'i dpe/ gting gsal phra ba'i ye shes dang*// shes bya 'byed la mthun gyur pa// lha yi rdzing ring dag gis ni// khyod thugs 'gran pa'i nus pa med// mdzes pa'i dpe/ khyod gsungs rgyud mang dbyangs dang ldan// ngang pa'i bu mos rgyud mang sgrogs// de lta na yang snyan pa'i dbyangs// mtshungs pa nyid las khyad 'phags min// de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/ 'di ni khyod kyi zhal bzang nyid// pad+ma rnam par rgyas pa min// 'di dag rta bdun dbang po'i gzi// ma yin khyod kyi sku yi 'od//

thun min dpe/ nyi ma zla ba dag gi ni// 'od zer las 'das mgon khyod kyi// sku yi 'od kyi dpe zla ni// khyod rang nyid dang mtshungs par 'gyur// byung min dpe/ bye ba phrag brgya'i bsil zer can// zhun du (13)(14) (15)gdams zab dza hū'i rgyun// thugs kyi dpal ber bskyil ba las// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mthor gshegs// mtha' dag mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas zhing*// rnam dpyod 'od zer rab tu dkar// thugs rjes bsil ba'i chu rgyun 'bebs// rnam 'dren zla ba gtsug na rol// cha shas/ 'jigs bral blo gter dbang po khyod kyi gsung*// snyan pa'i 'dab stong phyogs dus kun tu rgyas// grags pa'i ge sar stong khams yongs la bzhad// mngar ba'i sbrang rtsis ro 'dzin brtan pa 'phrog / cha shas can/ khyod kyi gsung gsang skye ba lnga pa'i dung*// mthong bas rang bzhin babs kyi bsam gtan skye// thos pas chog mi shes pa'i brtson 'grus 'byung*// reg pas lus sems shin sbyangs bde ba 'dren// yan lag gcig khyod ni rtsol bral blo 'das gdod ma'i dbyings// khyad chos drug ldan kun bzang rgyal sar gshegs// khyod nyid mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun// tshe 'dir grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gzhol// yan lag gnyis/ khyod ni nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i klong*// gting gsal phra ba'i ye shes chen po'i ngang*// phyi gsal (16)yon tan rma bya'i sgang chu'i tshul// ye nas ma brtsal lhun rdzogs nyid du gnas// yan lag gsum/ khyod thugs gzhi dbyings kun gsal yangs pa'i khyon// gzhi snang nyi zla skar gsum tshom bu bkra// rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'i cho rol la// longs su spyod pas ma spangs rang sar grol// ldan pa'i/ snga 'gyur kai la sha yi ngogs// khyod sku ri dwags rgyal po yis// gsung gi gdong lnga'i sgra bsgrags pas// lta man wa skyes klad pa 'gems// 'os min/

'dren mchog thub pa nyin mor byed// dge legs bye ba'i 'od stong gis// phan bde'i dpal gyi ku mud bzhad// ngo mtshar srid pa'i khongs na glengs// bstanapa mi mnyam/ khyod kyi gsung gi legs bshad snyan pa gang*// yid 'ong ka la piṅka tam+bu ra// sems la sim pa rab ster ku hu'i mgrin// bdag gi yid ni dbang med khyod la phyogs// khyad par bcas/ 'jigs bral khyod kyi zhabs sen gser gyi tog bsil ldan sa yi thig le'i la thod la// sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyal po/ bcings pas nag phyogs phru ma'i g.yul ngo las// rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan rgyal gyur cig / 'gal ba/ zang zing 'dod pa mi sbyin zhing*// rgyal mtshan rtse (17)(18)(19)(20)(21)(22) ma dpe nang mi 'dug (23)chen po byed// chos brgyad phyogs lhung ldan rnams kyis// sgro 'dogs skur 'debs ci dgar mdzod/

shis brjod/ lam 'dir mi mos skal med rnams// gnas skabs bde bas shis gyur cig / mthar thug zab lam snying po 'di'i// skal ba dag dang ldan gyur cig / rtsub mos 'gog pa/ yid srubs bdag pos dbang byas rnams// rang rang ci dgar 'jug la brtson// bdag ni grol ba don gnyer bas// theg pa'i rtse rgyal nyid la gzhol// yang na 'bras bu/ 'jigs bral gling pa gshegs nas dus ring song*// slob tshogs phal mo che rnams zhi bar gzims// 'on kyang kun mkhyen ngag dbang dpal bzang gi / gzugs sku nub pa med 'di ngo mtshar rmad// rjes gnang*/ ngag gi dbang khyod bzhed na zhi bar gzim// khyod nyid gshegs pas bdag ni lnga lam du// 'gro bas sdug bsngal yun ring myong mi 'gyur// bdag la khyod kyi dogs pa mdzad mi 'tshal/ yang na/ gal te gshegs par bzhed na zhi bar gzim// khyod ni gshegs pas 'gro ba'i bde skyid sgo// sangs rgyas bstan pa yun ring gnas mi 'gyur// 'on kyang 'di la khyod (24)ni dogs mi 'tshal// dbang gis 'gog pa/ zhing khams gzhan du sems can don// mtha' yas mang po bsgrub pa dang*// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur// 'on kyang mgon khyod gshegs mi bya// ma gus pas/ sems can bde 'dod stobs dang ldan// sdug bsngal 'dod pa su zhig yod// mgon po gshegs sam bzhugs lags sam// sems can gnas skabs smos pa lags// shis brjod/ mgon po gal te bzhed na gshegs// 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog / gang du bzhud der 'gro ba rnams// skyes nas mig dang ldan gyur cig / yang na/ ngag gi dbang khyod gshegs par bzhed na gshegs// khyod kyi lam ni bde zhing shis gyur cig / 'dir ni 'gro ba'i mig med bstan pa nub// gang du bzhud der skyes nas phun tshogs shog / rtsub mos 'gog pa/ gal te khyod gshegs bden nyid na// sngon chad bdag gir mdzad pa yi// sems can sdug bsngal dong du bskyur// thugs bskyed dam bca' chu la phos//

gros nyid/ grogs dag mi yi chos lugs ma spyad bar// thar pa dam pa'i lam la snga nas min// dgos med rgyud la 'dris pa bdag lta bus// chang dang dga' ba'i dga' ston stor la ltos// 'bad pas/ (25)'jig rten pa kun sems bsrung phyir// 'jig rten legs zhes brjod 'dod kyang*// rgyu mtshan shes pas mi legs zhes// kha nas shor la bdag ci byed// gzhan dbang*/ skad cig dge bar gegs byed rnam rig la// khro na legs smon can khyod bdag snying na// spro sems shugs drag de la gros gyis dang*// bdag gis de yis 'dod pa ji bzhin no// thabs kyis/ rdzogs chen lam la sgro skur sna tshogs dang*// bskal mang ngal dub dka' spyad bzod par bgyi// grangs med mang por tshe yi dngos grub dang*// stobs dang lang tsho rgyas pa'i bcud len rtsol// khro bas/ jo bo khyod kyi bstan pa'i snying po la// blo ma rangs pa'i tshig gcig kha nas byung*// skal ba dman pa khyod kyis bstan pa la// zhugs pa'i zol 'dis da ni ci zhig bya// snying rjes/ sgrib pa ma sbyangs tshogs ma bsags// thos bsam sgom pa'i lam ma bslab// dal rten thob kyang don med pa// kye ma 'di rnams sha re tsha// 'gyod pas/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i gdengs mi ldan// gzhan dring mi 'jog blo mi mnga'// gnang bkag khrims kyi ma bsdams par// lang tsho mtha' dag rga bas 'phrog / the tshom/ dri za'i lag gi (26)rgyud mang ngam// 'jigs bral khyod kyi gsung ngam ci// blang dor gnas kun legs ston pas// tam+bu ra yi sgra ma yin// sbyar pas/ dri bral kha dog phun sum tshogs// rin chen dang po yon che ba// khyod sku gser sbyang 'di yod bzhin// sa le sbram gzhan des ci bya// don gzhan/ mkhas pa'i dbang khyod yon tan tshogs// sdud la ngoms pa med pa mtshar// ti ma'i grong gi chu bran stong*// rgyun du 'thung yang ga la ngoms// rgyus 'gog

thams cad mkhyen ces nam yang ni// mgon po khyod la mi bstod de// gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*// mi yi rdzu la zhugs pa'i phyir/ bdun pa don gzhan bkod pa la brgyad las/ kun khyab/ bskal par gnas pa'i brtan dang g.yo// dam pa'i skyes bu skye rgu'i bdag /'di dag gnas pa'i mthu zad na// 'dus byas mtshan nyid su yis zlog / yang na/ bcom ldan 'gro ba rnams kyi mig /rdo rje'i sku can rdzogs sangs rgyas// mya ngan 'das pa'i tshul la ltos// 'chi bar nges la su yis bsnyon// khyad par la gnas/ rgyal sras rnams kyi sems can la// phan pa 'ba' zhig sgrub par byed// rang don yal bar 'dor rnams kyis// gzhan don kho na sgrub par mdzad// sbyar ba can/ (27)cha shas kun nas yon tan/ yongs gang zhing*/ sku 'od /'od zer rab 'phro chos kyis/ bdud rtsi'i ster// 'khor slob ma/ gyi phreng bas rab bskor ba'i// zla ba rang byung rgyal ba/ 'di ni thugs/ rab tu gsal// khyad chos tha dad mi dad/ ri dwags rtags kyis legs par spras// bsil zer zla ba'i chos/ bdud rtsi'i thun mongs/ 'byung gnas che// yon tan rang byung blo'i/ cha shas rab tu gang*// zla ba 'di ni bdag gis mthong*// sngon med bsdus brjod/ tshangs pa'i dpal dang mi ldan zhing*// mtshan mo gzhan du mi 'gro ba'i// nyin byed snang ba ngo mtshar ba// 'di ni bdag gi skal bas rnyed// bcu gcig pa phul byung rgyan la bzhi las/ khyad 'phags phul byung*/ rab dkar bla gos mthang gos dkar// sku mdog dkar 'tsher gzi brjid ldan// sprin dkar dbus bzhugs mgon khyod dang*// zla ba'i mdangs gnyis dbye ma nus// the tshom phul byung*/ rang byung rgyal ba khyod la ni// sha rus pags pa las grub pa'i// mtshan gzhi'i sku zhig yod dam med// bdag gi blo 'di 'phyang mo nyug / nges pa'i phul byung*/ mgon po khyod kyi mdzad pa dang*// gsung rab mthong thos mngon gyur na/

(28)/mi yi rdzu la zhugs pa yi// sku lus yod pas the mi tshom// grags pa phul byung*/ 'jigs bral khyod kyi yon tan ni// blo yi rwa ba las 'das kyang*// 'dir ni shong bas 'dzin ma'i khyon// e ma rab tu yangs la ltos// bcu gnyis pa rab rtog gi rgyan la gsum las/ sems ldan rab rtog ni/ bsil ba'i reg pas gdungs ba'i mtsho byung ma// khyod kyi thugs kyi pad mtshor dgyes bzhugs nas// snyan pa'i rgyud mang 'khrol dang lhan cig par// gsung dbyangs legs bshad chos rnga sgrogs so snyam/ sems med rab rtog mgon khyod da lta gar bzhugs zhes// nyi zlas gling bzhi bskor nas btsal// chu klung dag kyang rnam par rgyug /ri rab lang nas phyogs phyogs blta// yang na sems ldan rab rtog khyod nyid mchims phur sgrub la gzhol ba'i tshe// klong chen rab 'byams yang yang byon pa ni// khyod kyi sgrub tshugs sus kyang 'gran med pa// ltad mo gzigs pa'i phyir du lhags sam snyam// sems med rab rtog glegs bam kyis ni khyod gsung bcud// lhag ma med par 'thung bas myos// khyod las lhag pa'i don byed ces// khyod kyi gtsug tu 'jog gam snyam// ting nge 'dzin gyi rab rtog sku yi phyi (29)nang bzhugs gnas thams cad la// 'ja' 'od thig le thig phran byug pa bzhin// nam mkha'i nyi zlas 'ja' tshon sku thig rnams// 'dzad pa med pa'i gru char 'bebs pa bzhin// bcu gsum pa rgyu rgyan bcu drug las/ rgyu 'bras dngos po 'os pa/ khyod kyi gsung gi legs bshad 'dis// bka' dang dgongs 'grel tshig don rnams// lhag ma med par rtogs nus phyir// blo ldan rnams kyi dga' ba bskyed// 'bras bu dngos med mi 'os pa/ mgrin pa glu yi dkor mdzod las// rdol ba'i legs bshad bcud myong bas// bag med dbang du gyur rnams kyis// dpa' dang brtul phod nyams par byed// rnam 'gyur rgyu/

mthon mthing ral pa'i glegs bam can// blta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpe'i sku// mdzes pa'i mchog kyang phyogs zhen gyis// 'ga' zhig mthong ba'i dug tu 'gyur// thob byed rgyu/ skal ba can du bya'o zhes// gzur gnas mkhas pa'i drung bkod la// rang byung rgyal ba de'i gsung rab// legs bshad dag la 'dris su gzhug phyi dus shes byed/ zla ba gang ba rgyal la zhugs// bco brgyad nyin byed snang ba des// kun gsal yangs pa'i mtha' nyul tshe// rnal 'byor (30)tshogs kyi dga' ston byed// nang gnas skabs shes pa'i rgyu/ khyod kyi dbang du gyur pa'i yid// mdza' gcugs bshes kyis ma zlog cing*// gtum pa'i dgras kyang ma brlag pa// 'od skur dengs pa nyid kyis shes/ snga na med pa'i byed rgyu/ gnang bkag tshul la ma bslab zhing*// thos bsam sgro 'dogs gcod ma byas// rtogs pa'i gdengs dang ma ldan pas// bdag ni 'jigs pas gdung bar gyur// phan tshun med pa'i rgyu/ shing drung bya skyibs khyim ma yin// rdo rje dril bu mdza' mo min// chu klung spang ljongs gnyen ma yin// da ni nges par dben gnas 'grim// zhig nas med pa'i byed rgyu/ rtsed mo 'dod pas myos pa song*// lang tsho'i rgyags pa bor nas thal// tshe 'di'i don gnyer phal cher zhig / dge ba 'ba' zhig yid la gcags// spang nas med pa'i byed rgyu/ 'du 'dzi 'khor ba'i brel do ni// rang byung rgyal ba khyod la med// de phyir slob mar bcas rnams kyis// snying po'i sgrub pa 'ba' zhig byed// rgyu dngos med kyi 'bras bu dngos med bskyed pa'i rgyu rgyan/ rang byung rgyal khyod 'gro gzhan gyi// gnas su ma byon pa min na// gling 'di rtag chad smra ba yi// mun pa 'thug po 'khrigs par 'gyur// ring 'bras/ (31)'jigs bral khyod kyi gzugs kyi sku// gser gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba des// gzhan dag mnga' 'og bsdus pa na// bdag yid rang dbang bral bas 'dud//

lhan cig skyes rgyu/ skal ldan rtogs pas myos pa gang*// sa lam yon tan gcig char rdzogs// khyod zhal bstan dang lhan cig tu// dbang bzhi rim pa min par sbyin// 'bras ma thag skyes/ sngar nyid gzhi la gnas pa'i khams// yon tan rgya mtsho rab tu rgyas// phyis nas khyod thugs chu 'dzin las// sbrang char zim bu'i smin byed ster// rigs min/ lha gcig khyod kyi legs bshad kyi// bdud rtsi'i gru char dbab pa las// skye rgu rnams kyi sred pa yi// chu bdag skam par byed pa ci// rigs pa'i rgyu/ khyod kyi gsung gsang bdud rtsi'i char// chad pa med par rtag 'jo bas// skal bar ldan pa'i blo gros kyi// rin chen 'byung gnas rab tu rgyas// bcu bzhi pa phra mo'i rgyan gnyis las/ zur gyi phra mo/ khyod kyis rdul bral zhi ba nyid// smrar med bde ba'i ye shes mchog /mngon du byas so zhes mtshon byed// sems nyid ngal bso'i phyag rgya mdzad// rnam pa'i phra mo/ khyod kyi spyan ni 'bru (32)tshugs su// gang la gtad pa'i yul rnams kyang*// rtogs dang grol ba dus mnyam par// sa lam bsgrod du med par byas/ bco lnga pa cha yi rgyan la bzhi/ sbed 'os cha'i rgyan/ khyod zhal mthong bas rtogs pa ngo 'phrod pa// tshogs su sgrib byed/ khyod kyi dag pa'i bzhin ras ni// legs byas tshogs kyis bskyed snyam pas// rdzi ma bskyod pa ma yin par// 'dren byed lha yi rjes su song*// mi 'os pa/ dad pas mchi ma 'khrugs pa tshogs su sgrib byed/ yon tan rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid kyi// ngo mtshar ltad mo mthong 'dod kyang*// de la 'gran pa'i rlung g.yos pa'i// rdul gyis bdag mig sun phyung ngo*// zol smad/ phas rgol g.yul ngo bzlog la dpa'// bu smad gnyen 'dun skyong la mdzangs// gtso bor tshe 'di 'ba' zhig gnyer// zhor du dam chos sgrub la mkhas/ zol bstod/ khyod kyis sa zhing khang bzang skyed mos tshal// bu smad mdza' grogs rnyed mang bkur sti sogs// tshe 'di'i bde skyid phun tshogs rab spangs nas// smyon pa bzhin du ltos med rgyu 'di ci//

༈ yang na khyad 'phags yul byung*/ rang byung rgyal ba khyod kyi gsang gsum gyi// bsgrang yas yon tan tshogs dang phyogs dus (33)kyi// rgyal ba'i yon tan tha dad mtshon nus pa'i// blo yi spobs pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs la ci// the tshom phul byung*/ snying stobs chen pos rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i dus// bzung nas smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab// pad dkar ltar bsngags mgon de khyod nyid dam// du mar 'phrul ba gang yin nem nur gzhi// nges pa'i phul byung*/ snyigs ma'i snyigs mar gyur pa'i 'gro tshogs rnams// 'brel tshad gdod ma'i gzhi la skyes mdzad pas// smon lam lnga brgya'i grangs las rab brgal bas// rgyal las lhag pa khyod nyid yod par nges// grags pa'i phul byung*/ khyod kyi snyan dang grags pa ring song ba// sku gsum zhing khams rgya mtshos 'dzin ma nus// 'gro ba'i sgron ma rnam par bkod pa'i tshe// 'di tsam chung ba rgyal rnams ci zhig nongs// sems med rab rtog zla zhun dwangs ma 'thag pa'i bla gos 'od// 'gran phyir ri bong 'dzin pas skyed dang sdud// lan brgyar 'bad rtsol thabs mkhas brtson brtson yang*// ma nus skyong la 'phya phyir ku mud bzhad// snyam sgra can/ khyod kyi legs (34)bshad sgo brgya dbye ba gang*// sgra 'dzin zung gis nyan par mi nus ces// ngang pa'i shing rta zhon nas mi yul du// 'chi med rna ba brgyad pa lhags sam snyam// legs sgra can/ mthong na mi mthun med pa'i sku lus kyang*// lhab lhub gos kyi rnam par g.yogs pa las// mtshan dpe'i yon tan gzhan gyis rab mthong na// sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul sku brjod par dogs// nges sgra can/ gter ston rkyang pa'i skye ba bcu gsum bar// sems can phan bde 'ba' zhig sgrub pa yang*// srid zhi'i yon tan lhag ma ma lus pa// gcig tu spungs te bdag gir mdzad par nges// 'dra sgra can/ yon tan bgrang las 'das pa'i khyod kyi gzi// 'dren byed zung gi blta bar mi nus zhes// skabs gsum bdag pos mig dbang stong phrag tu// sprul nas khyod zhal gzi brjid blta ba 'dra//

min nam can/ khyod kyi snyan grags dbyangs can bye ba brgyas// kun tu bsgrags pas rigs lnga gangs can mtsho// kun tu skyeng sa nas dag pa'i zhing du yibs// thun mong snang ngor ma bzhugs pa min nam// bzhin sgra can/ khyod kyi chos srung slob mas (35)bskor ba la// 'gran phyir ri rgyal lhun po dbus bzhugs nas// ri phran rnams kyis bskor yang bshad ma shes// lha yi rnga sgra grogs su sbran pa bzhin// bcu drug pa rim pa can gyi rgyan/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mgon khyod kyi// dbu skyes zhal ras spyan dkyus ring*// kun gsal zla gzhon ut+pal la'i// lang tsho 'phrog pa nyid du nges// bcu bdun pa dga' ba'i nyams la gnyis las/ dngos thob kyi dga' ba/ rang byung rgyal khyod 'dir pheb pa// mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba// de 'dra'i dga' ba gzhan las min// de ni yang yang 'byung bar smon//

gzugs brnyan dga' ba/ ma 'ongs pa na glegs bam kyis// bstan pa'i rgyun rab bzung nas kyang*// blang dor lam ni ston byed pas// gzugs sku mthong yang nged kyi ci// bco brgyad pa nyams ldan gyi rgyan la brgyad yod pa las/ dga' ba 'phel ba sgeg pa'i nyams/ zhi bar gzims zhes grags pas pha rol du// zhabs drung skye bar smon nas bdag 'chi 'dod// 'jigs med gling zhes grags de bdag gis ni// e ma mngon sum mthong 'di dga' ba la// khro ba 'phel ba drag shul gyi nyams/ gang zhig snying po'i bstan la rma 'byin pa'i// sdig can de dag (36)sde dang dpung bcas pa// sngags srung rak+ṣa drag tu khros pa yis// lcags kyi sder mos snying rtsa dbang med phrogs/ spro ba 'phel ba dpa' ba'i nyams/ yun ring 'bad pa la mi ltos// lo dang zla ba tsam gyis kyang*// khyad chos drug ldan gzhi dbyings su// ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'di ngo mtshar// mya ngan 'phel ba snying rje'i nyams/ tshor bde 'ba' zhig gnyer ba'i lug rnams kyang*// shan pas bzung nas lus po mgo mjug ldog mig nas 'chi ma khra la la bab kyang*// nyes med gsod la snying rje dbang med mdzad// skyugs bro ba 'phel ba mi sdug pa'i nyams/ lus 'di mi gtsang 'dam las byung*// srog chags nyal nyil mang po dang*// gcin dang rtug pas rab gang ba'i// mi gtsang gzeb 'di skyon du gzigs// dgod bro ba 'phel ba bzhad dgad kyi nyams/ 'dod pas bslus ba'i mi bdag gis// bud med rta byas rta skad 'don// de 'dra'i nyon mongs can yang 'dis// nyon mongs lam du khyer thabs bstan// yang na/ chos gos gyon pa'i dge slong tshul 'dzin zhing*// bud med gam du song nas 'dod pa'i don// gsol ba btab kyang de yi khas ma blangs// chos dang 'gal zhes len brgyar smra bar byas// (37) ngo mtshar 'phel ba rmad byung gi nyams/ rang byung rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// yon tan rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid can// mthong dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// nges par gdod ma'i grol gzhir phyin//

bag tsha ba 'phel ba 'jigs rung gi nyams/ khyod kyi bka' sdod mi srun drag shul can// 'jigs rung me dang gnam lcags thog lta bu// dran pa tsam gyis bdud sde'i snying gi khrag / chil chil skyug na dngos su smros ci 'tshal// bcu dgu pa gzi brjid kyi rgyan/ rang byung rgyal 'dis 'brel tshad sangs rgyas la// bkod do zhes pas khyod nyid ma 'jigs dang*// da dung 'khor ba'i bde bar mngon zhen na// btsan thabs nyid kyis 'god par mdzad ma yin// nyi shu pa rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan/ nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i klong*// snang bzhi'i lam bzang bgrod pa'i phyir// bdag gis rang byung rgyal la bsten// grogs dag thugs la gang bzhed mdzod// nyer gcig pa kun phan gyi rgyan/ snyigs ma'i lta ngan thibs po yis// lam dang lam min mi shes par// ngan 'gror chas la brtson pa'i tshe// khyod kyi yang dag snang ba ston// nyer gnyis pa rgya che ba'i rgyan la gnyis las/ bsam pa rgya che ba/ (38)dug lnga drag tu 'khrugs pa'i sems can gyis// gshe skur mtshon cha'i char ltar 'bebs pa la// khros na srid gsum brlag pa'i mthu ldan yang*// snying rje chen pos bde blag grol bar mdzad// 'byor pa rgya che ba/ ma 'ongs sangs rgyas zhing khams bye ba brgya'i// 'byor pas tsha tsam bsgrun du med pas na// rnam par rgyal ba can du 'tshang rgya bar// bden smra'i tshogs kyis lung gi cod pan byin// nyer gsum pa bsnyon dor gyi rgyan la gsum las/ chos la bsnyon dor/ shes bya'i chos tshul rab 'byams pa// ye shes gcig gis mkhyen zer yang*// chos can ji snyed de'i grangs kyi// ye shes de snyed yod par nges// yul la bsnyon dor/ zhal bzang zla ba lta ba gang*// lta spyod phyin ci log rnams kyi// blta ba'i dug tu gyur pa ni// gzhan la 'chi gsos sman du snang*// rang bzhin bsnyon dor/ gnod 'tshe rdeg 'tshog byed pa la// dgra zhes rab tu grags mod kyang*// khyod kyi bzod pa phun sum tshogs// 'grub pa'i rgyu rnams dgra ma yin//

nyer bzhi pa sbyar ba'i rgyan la/ tshig tha dad min pa'i sbyor ba/ pad+ma las skyes skye rgu'i bdag / (39)gnyis skyes mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor// mkhas par byed pa'i lam bzang ston/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed// gu ru rin po che la go na/ mtsho las skyes shing snying rjes sems can bdag gir mdzad/ lhan skyes zhing sngags kyi mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor zhing mdo sngags kyi chos ston/ bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'jigs med gling pa la go na/ pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gdams pas rgyud grol mchog thun gyi dngos grub bsgrubs pa las skyes pa sogs/ tshangs pa la go na/ khyab 'jug gi lte ba las skyes skye dgu'i bdag po ming dngos lha'i bu mos bskor/ rig byed ston/ chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ ༈ tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyor ba/ shes bya'i chos rnams kun khyab 'jug /gcig las du mar rnam par 'phrul// 'chi ba med pa'i mgon po mchog /'gro ba rnams kyi phan bde 'byung*// gu ru rin po che la go na/ chos nyid kyis chos can la khyab/ sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya/ rdo rje'i sku brnyes/ 'gro don mdzad pa dang*/ 'jigs med gling pa la go na/ lha yul na sku sprul bdun/ mi yul na gsung sprul bdun/ klu yul na thugs sprul bdun/ tshe dpag med/ spyan ras (40) gzigs sogs kyi rnam 'phrul sogs la go ba dang*/ khyab 'jug la go na/ khyab 'jug ming dngos dang*/ 'jug pa bcu/ lha'i bdag po sogs dang*/ dbang phyug la go na bde 'byung zhes pa'i ming dngos dang*/ sprul pa phyi nang gi 'dod tshul mang ba sogs/ ༈ bya ba tha dad min pa'i sbyor ba/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan mnga'// bstan dang 'gro ba yongs kyi gsos// rang byung rgyal dang mtsho skyes rjes// rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa spel// bya ba 'gal min sbyor ba/ zhi bsil bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nyid// yang dag thar lam snang ba ston// legs bshad rna ba'i bcud du smin// bslab pa mig gi 'bras bur btsal/

bya ba 'gal ba'i sbyar ba/ gnyis skyes lang tshos rab sgeg pa// yid 'ong bde la zhen byed gang*// bram ze gangs can 'dir mi snang*// gzhan pa rnams ni 'di ru snang*// bud med/ zla ba/ 'dab chags sogs/ ༈ nges pa can gyi sbyar ba/ pad+ma'i ljags ldan 'jigs bral gling*/ / bla ma dgongs 'dus las drug 'byung bar gsungs pa ngos 'dzin tshul mi 'dra ba shin tu mang yang*/ mnga' ris pad+ma dbang rgyal dang*/ 'di dag ni mi 'gyur ba'i rtags gsum re dang ldan no/ gnyis skyes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la// sha za nyid la gnod pa'i sems// smin ma 'khyog la gya gyu can// khyod kyis bskyang la mthar lta ni// tarka sde lnga kho nar gnas/ (41)/lus skyes dad pa'i spu long rgyas// yon tan phung po can der mos/ nges pa 'gog pa'i sbyar ba/ khyod kyis skyabs la nag po ni// chos min/ bsam/ sbyor ba/ kha dog sogs/ /'bri ba'i snag tsha nyid la'o// 'on kyang zhe sdang rgyas pa yi// 'thab la bsam pa de ltar mthong*// khyad chos 'gal min/ rtag tu tshangs pa/ zhi ba bdud rtsi'i bdag /yid las snying rjes/ skyes pas mnga' dbang bsgyur// dga' ba byams pa/ brgya pas khyab 'jug don kun grub// rin chen 'byung gnas rgya mtsho/ gting yon tan/ dpag dka'// khyad chos 'gal ba can/ dga' rab rdo rje'i sprul pa'am dga' rab dbang phyug yin yang mda' lngas 'dod lha/ min// bde 'byung skyid thams cad kyi gnas sam dbang phyug yin yang chags ldan min// mes po sangs rgyas kun gyi 'am tshangs pa/ yin yang gdong bzhi min// sred med chags pa med pa'am khyab 'jug yin yang g.yo sgyus min/ /nyer lnga pa khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan la lnga/ yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par/ blo ldan khyod kyi legs bshad mtsho// dkar ba ma yin mngar ba min// 'on kyang dpyod ldan rnams kyis ni// ngoms pa med pa btung bar byed// rigs ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/ tshangs dbang lha yi sras ma yin// rgyal dang bram (42)ze'i rigs min kyang*// sa gsum skye rgu'i tshogs rnams kyis// khyod nyid spyi bos mchod par 'os//

bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad brjod/ mdzes pa'i bzhin ras ma ston zhing*// snyan pa'i ngag gis ma bos kyang*// bdag gi yid ni dbang med du// 'phrog byed ye shes rol pa rtsal// rdzas ma tshang ba'i khyad brjod/ khyod gsung snying la nges gnas na// sra ba'i go dang rno ba'i mtshon// dpung tshogs bzhi dang mi ldan yang*// pha rol dgra yis brlag mi nus// rgyu ma tshang ba'i khyad brjod/ mnga' thang stobs 'byor ldan pa min// dka' thub lus can gcig pur gnas// de lta na yang yon tan gyis// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por gyur// nyer drug pa mtshungs par sbyor ba'i rgyan gnyis las/ bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor/ ma hā tsi nar zur phud lnga// gru 'dzin ri bor mig mi 'dzum// ljongs 'dir khyod la ston pa zhes// 'jig rten pa kun mtshungs par gleng*// smad pa'i mtshungs sbyor/ tshul gsum rtags dang 'gal 'brel dpyod// dngos stobs rigs pa mi ldan pas// rgol yang khron pa'i sbal pa yis// rgya mtsho mthong nas 'chi ba (43)bzhin/ nyer bdun pa 'gal rgyan drug las/ gzhi tha dad pa'i bya ba 'gal ba/ khyod kyi gsung rab legs bshad kyis// gzu bor gnas pa'i mkhas pa yi// yid 'ong dga' ba rnam par rgyas// phyogs lhung can rnams de ltar min// byed pa 'gal ba/ lung rigs 'thad ldan brgal brtag gis// snga rgol mi smra'i gnas su sbyar// phyi rgol rnams kyi a la la// dga' ba'i gad rgyangs rab tu sgrogs// chos 'gal ba/ gdong ni dkar dang dmar ba'i mdangs// spyan ni khro la zhal ni 'dzum// dkar min spyan la tshems phreng dkar// khyod kyi zhal 'dis su ma bcom// rdzas 'gal/ zla ba'i gdong la pad+ma'i mchu// mu tig tshems la bung ba'i mig / mig sman skra la gzha' tshon lus// de yis gdung nus min nam ci// las 'gal/ khyod kyi gsung dbyangs snyan cing 'jebs// nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pa des// log smra wa skyes tshogs rnams kyi// dran byed shor nas brgyal bar byed//

sbyar 'gal/ theg chen sngags kyi lam la gshegs/ gu ru rin po che dang sbyar/ gnam sngon bzhu pa'i zhun ma'i dbus// pir gyis bris 'dra'i bkod legs par// dgra la lhag par brtse ba yi// mgon la su zhig yid brtan 'cha'// grub gnyis lang tsho rab brtan pa// rang byung rgyal khyod rtog ge pa// phal cher (44)sdang bas su yid rton/ nyer brgyad skabs min bstod pa/ 'brel tshad don ldan mgon khyod la// khro zhing gshe ba'i sems ldan dag /'khor ba mtha' can nyid 'gyur phyir// bskal pa bzang por phyogs pa yin// nyer dgu pa zol bstod gsum las/ mthu phun tshogs/ zas gtsang rgyal srid bral ba des// khams gsum dgra las rnam rgyal na// 'jigs bral khyod kyi tshe gcig gis// grub kyang khengs pa ci la mdzad// dpa' ba phun tshogs/ rigs gsum mgon po'i mkhyen brtse nus// 'phrogs nas khyod kyi bdag gir byed// rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa la// de 'dra'i bya ba rigs sam ci// stobs phun sum tshogs/ khyod kyi chos kyi phrin las ni// lag 'gro'i lus po tsam la khyab// ci slad khyod kyi nga rgyal ni// mchog gi mtha' ru 'dzogs par 'gyur// sum cu pa nges bstan rgyan gnyis las/ mchog nges brtan/ dbyar skyes sprin gyi rnga sgra yis// gtsug phud can la dga' ba ster// khyod kyi legs bshad grags snyan des// skal bzang kun dga'i dpal ster phyir// mchog min nges bstan/ thub pa'i gsungs la 'gong pa yis/ (45)/lhas sbyin gson po dmyal mes tshig / bslab las phyi rol gyur pa rnams// 'khor ba'i gnas las thar dka' mtshon// so gcig pa lhan cig brjod pa la gsum las/ yon tan lhan gcig brjod pa/ zla ba gzhon nu mdzes pa dang*// khyod kyi bla gos lhan cig dkar// 'chi ba med pa'i lam chen dang*// khyod kyi thugs nyid lhan cig yangs// rgyu 'bras/ rtogs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs pa dang*// lhan cig dgongs pa'i byin brgyud 'pho// 'pho chen 'od sku 'grub pa dang*// lhan cig rig pa 'od la 'jug

/ bya ba/ tshul khrims gnang bkag gtsang ma dang*// thos bsam sgro 'dogs chod pa dang*// goms pa rab tu gyur pa rnams// lhan cig dag tu 'phail bar 'gyur// so nyis pa yongs su brjes pa/ bdag snying dad pa'i 'dab g.yo ba'i// rdul dmar dag ni khyod kyis 'phrog /khyod kyi legs gsung sbra ma ra// bdag yid rkang 'thung dag la brtsen// so gsum pa shis brjod kyi rgyan/ /phyi tshul gnang bkag gtsang ma dang*// nang du bsam pa bzang po dang*// gsang ba rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi/ (46)/snang ba dam pas khyod la srungs// so bzhi pa rab spel gyi rgyan la gnyis las/ 'brel mtshungs/ 'jigs med gling pas kun mkhyen chen po'i ye shes kyi sku zhal mjal bas dad pa skyes pa bsdus brjod gtsor ston/ bsod nams bye ba'i gzugs/ chu gter la// bris pa med pa'i srid pa can/ snang brnyan bkra// zla ltar dpe/ dkar ba'i ku mud rnams// ngo mtshar rab rtog skyes nas bzhad do snyam// stobs mtshungs/ 'jigs pa med rang bzhin/ pa'i blo ldan gyis// mkhyen dpe/ pas nyi zlar co 'dri zhing*// legs bshad gzugs/ sgra brgya pa yi dbyangs// 'gro don rab rtog nam mkha'i ltor ma shong*// dgongs pa can/ srid zhi'i 'jigs med mthu brnyes kyang*// gling 'dir brtse bas rang byung ba'i// rdo rje slob dpon chen po la// tshe rabs kun tu bsngags pa'i yul// snyan ngag me long ma'i dper brjod sarga gnyis pa'o//// ༈ le'u tha ma'i don la gsum gyi/ dang po la'ang zung ldan la nang gses drug las/ bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/ skang pa dang po'i thog ma'i zung ldan/ mdzes so mdzes so khyod kyi zhal// mthong na mi mthun med pa dang*// blta bas ngoms pa med pa de// sngon gyi legs smon mthu las byung*// rkang pa gnyis pa/ khyod kyi legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun// lhung lhung rna (47)ba'i bcud du son// legs nyes blang dor 'byed pa la// gzhan dring mi 'jog spobs pa skyes//

gsum pa/ thub pa'i legs bshad ti ma'i grong*// lhag med khyod kyi thugs mtshor bskyil// legs legs srid zhi'i legs tshogs kyi// dal 'gro ma lus sdud la ltos// bzhi pa/ khyod kyi snyan pa'i grags pa ni// ring du song ba kun gsal gyis// 'dzin mi nus pa'i chung ngu de// byed byed bdag po ci zhig nongs// dang po gnyis/ legs legs bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi// mdzes mdzes don bzang ma lus pa// lhun po'i rtse nas bltas pa na// gzhan dag mnga' 'og chud bzhin mkhyen// dang po gsum pa/

chung chung byis pa'i sku dus nas// sems kyi rang bzhin tshol bar byed// rgas rgas zhig la dris na yang*// lus 'dra chung ngu zhig yod smras// dang po bzhi pa/ legs legs sngon byon dam pa'i khyu// sa lam rim par bgrod pa bzhin// tshogs lam chos rgyun yon tan tshogs// myur myur zla ba drug gis 'grub/ gnyis pa gsum pa/ ka dag lhun grub dbyer med pa// zab zab (48)dgongs pa'i gding rnyed nas// grub grub mthar thug 'bras bu mchog / tshe 'di nyid la mngon du byas/ gnyis pa bzhi pa/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug pa// dka' dka' rgyud don rgya mtsho'i 'jings*// rang gis spobs pa kho na yis// mtshar mtshar lhag ma med pa 'thung*// gsum pa bzhi pa/ lhag pa'i lha yi bsnyen sgrub la// ting 'dzin brtan pos gzir ba las// zim zim dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo// chil chil sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams khol// dang po gsum/ legs legs yon tan rgya mtsho can// mdzes mdzes dam pa'i yul rnams la// snyan snyan tshig gi rgyan rnams las// brten nas bsngags pa'i glu dbyangs len// dang po gnyis pa bzhi pa/ mtshar mtshar 'khor lo rnam gsum gyis// mdzes mdzes rgyal bstan rin po che// bshad sgrub bya ba'i las rnams kyis// ngam ngam shugs kyis skyong bar mdzod/ dang po gsum bzhi/ mkhas mkhas tshugs brtan tshul bzang ba// thos bsam sgom pas 'chad rtsod brtsom// bzang bzang mkhas pa'i tshul dgu yis// mdzes mdzes 'dzam gling rgyan du byas/ gnyis gsum bzhi pa/ thugs sgam (49)tshig btsan blo gros zab// nges nges spyod pa lhur mi len// 'jigs 'jigs bral ba'i brtul zhugs can// zhum zhum med pa'i snying stobs mnga'/ bzhi ka can/ rgyas rgyas spyod pa rgya mtsho la// yang yang brtson pa 'phel ba dang*// zab zab don rnams ma lus pa// mang mang 'gro khams rgya mtshor ston// gnyis pa bar du chod pa la/ rkang pa snga ma gnyis/

grangs med gong nas tshogs gnyis bsags// grangs med gzhan phan dam bca' ni// bgrangs yas yon tan ma lus pa// yid can rgya mtshos thob pa'i phyir// rkang pa dang po gsum pa/ kun tu bzang po'i dgongs dpyod kyi// rnam par thar pa'i rjes su phyogs// kun mkhyen 'gro ba'i bla ma ni// 'jig rten gsum na 'gran zla bral// dang po bzhi pa/ dge legs yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter// dus ring gong nas smon lam dang*// snyigs mar gyur pa'i bsod nams kyi// dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid du grub// gnyis pa gsum pa/ snga na med pa'i ngo mtshar 'phrul// ma bslabs chos kun mkhyen pa dang*// ma btsal gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su// khyad (50)chos drug gis bgrod pa mtshar// gnyis pa bzhi pa/ thub pa'i spyan sngar rig pa 'dzin// dri ma med par grags pa dang*// rtsod ldan sngags kyi rig 'dzin mchog / dri med 'od zer gnyis pa khyod// gsum pa bzhi pa/ dge legs bye ba'i 'byung gnas che// dam chos bdud rtsi'i klung chen po// gzhan dring mi 'jog mkhyen rab mthus// gzhan phan sgo brgya 'byed mdzad mchog / dang po gnyis gsum/ kun gsal chos dbyings klong chen por// kun khyab nam mkha'i nor bu mchog / kun bzang rnal 'byor he ru kaḥ mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer bla ma rje// dang po gsum bzhi/ 'jigs bcas srid dang zhi ba'i mtha'// rnam grol ye shes chen po'i dpyid// 'jigs bral chos sku'i klong du bzlum// 'jigs med gling zhes srid na snyan// gnyis gsum bzhi pa/ gdod nas spros bral chos kyi sku// rang bzhin smra bsam brjod las 'das// rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// rang byung rdo rjes khyod la srungs// bzhi ka na/ gang la yon tan mchog mnga' ba// gang zhig dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyod// gang dag sems can thams cad kyi// gang phyir bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing*// (51) snga ma gnyis dang phyi ma gnyis zung ldan/

kun khyab gdod ma'i mgon po mchog / kun bzang khyad chos drug ldan gyis// mkha' khyab sems can ma lus pa// mkha' ltar dag pa'i lam la sbyor// gcig gsum dang*/ gnyis bzhi'i zung ldan/ sgrib pas bsgribs pa'i sems can la// rnam kun mkhyen pa'i dpa' bo yis// sgrib pa'i dri ma 'khrud pa dang// rnam dag spros bral mchog la sbyor// gcig bzhi dang*/ gnyis gsum/ chos dbyings kun khyab mtha' dang bral// 'od gsal ye shes chen po'i gdangs// 'od zer snang ba rab bkra ba// chos nyid bsam mi khyab pa'i yul// gsum pa chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan la/ snga ma gnyis 'dra zhing phyi ma gnyis 'dra ba/ zhim zhim rdul dmar bcud len de// zhim zhim rwa yig gnyis pas bzhin// mdzes mdzes kun bzang dgongs pa'i mthil// mdzes mdzes snga 'gyur ba'i khyad chos// dang po dang gsum pa/ gnyis pa dang bzhi pa mtshungs pa/ lam lam rab mdzes sprin dkar gyis// mer mer chu yi phung po 'dzin// lam lam gos dkar sngags sde yis/ (52)/mer mer rgyal ba'i thugs mdzod 'dzin// bzhi kar yod pa/ mdzes mdzes nyi gzhon gsar pa yis// mdzes mdzes snang ba 'bum phrag la// mdzes mdzes rang byung sangs rgyas kyis// mdzes mdzes las can 'bum phrag drangs// bya dka' ba la/ rkang pa bzhi ka'i dbus na yod pa'i chod ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ bdud bzhi las rgyal rgyal ba'i dbang po dang*// mngal sbubs las rgyal rgyal ba gnyis sogs kyis// som nyi las rgyal rgyal ba'i lung gis zin// rtsod ldan las rgyal rgyal ba rang byung rje// bzhi ka'i dbus na yod pa chod pa'i zung ldan/ kun bzang rgyal ba rgyal kun spyi mes che// kun mkhyen rgyal ba rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul 'gyed// rang byung rgyal ba rgyal sras dpa' bo mchog 'jigs bral rgyal bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin/ rkang pa bzhi ka'i mtha' nas yod pa bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ khyod kyi mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor mthong*// legs bshad don bzang glegs bam mthong*// yid ches dad pa'i rgyu mtshan mthong*// phyir mi ldog pa'i nges shes mthong*//

rkang pa bzhi ka'i mthar chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor sku mtshar mtshar// tshangs (53)dbyangs drug cu'i gsung mtshar mtshar// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i thugs mtshar mtshar// ye shes phung po nyid mtshar mtshar// bar mtha' na yod pa'i chod pa'i zung ldan/ stong nyid spros bral zab pa'i chos nyid zab// rten 'byung snang ba zab pa'i rgyu 'bras zab// bden gnyis zung 'jug zab pa'i bdag nyid zab// de nyid dpyod byed zab pa'i shes rab zab// dbus mthar chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ bskyed pa'i lha zab zab pa'i sku zab zab// bzlas pa'i sngags zab zab pa'i gsung zab zab// mi 'gyur dgongs zab zab pa'i thugs zab zab// 'phro 'du'i las zab zab pa'i gzer zab zab// thog mar chod pa'i zung ldan/ zab zhi spros bral zab don mthar thug pa// zab gsal gnyis med zab pa'i klong chen po// zab lam dbang bzhis zab don rjen par bstsal// zab mo lta spyod zab mo sgrub la dbang*// dang po gsum pa'i mtha' thog dang gnyis pa bzhi pa'i thog bar bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ zab zab snang stong zung 'jug gzhi zab zab// zab zab bskyed rdzogs zab zab zung 'jug lam// zab zab sku thugs zung 'jug 'bras zab zab// zab zab gsang sngags zab zab myur ba'i lam// (54) bzhi ka'i thog mtha' chod ma chod kyi zung ldan/ zab mo'i lta sgom spyod pa zab// zab khyad rab tu mang pos zab// zab lam bde myur bgrod pa zab// zab chos 'di 'dra dkon pas zab// bzhi ka'i thog mtha' ma chod chod pa'i zung ldan/ zab zab dam tshig phyag rgya'i sku zab zab// zab zab chos kyi phyag rgya'i gsung zab zab// zab zab ye shes phyag rgya'i thugs zab zab// zab zab las kyi phyag rgya'i 'phrul zab zab// bzhi ka'i thog mtha' dbus gsum kar yod pa chod ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ zab lam bskyed rim zab pas ma hā zab// zab myur rdzogs rim zab pas a nu zab// zab gsal dbyings rig zab pas a ti zab// zab khyad mang pos zab pas nang rgyud zab//

rkang pa bzhi ka'i thog mtha' bar gsum du ma chod chod pa'i zung ldan/ zab zab 'khor lo rnam bzhis zab zab 'jam dpal sku zab zab// zab zab rta skad thengs gsum zab zab pad+ma gsung zab zab// zab zab ru lu 'bru brgyad zab zab yang dag thugs zab zab// zab zab thal 'byin rnam bzhi zab zab phur pa'i las zab zab// thog mthar sbyar ba'i zung ldan/ rang byung rdo rje'i rgyal ba khyod// khyod kyi che ba'i yon tan (55)gang*// gang zhig 'dzam gling btsal kyang dkon// dkon par ma zad rnyed mi 'gyur// yang na/ khyab bdag ston pa 'od mi 'gyur// mi 'gyur dwangs pa'i pad mtshor skyes// mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i phrin las can// las can gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong*// bzhi pa kun tu zung ldan gyi rkang pa bzlas pa la/ tshig bcad phyed bzlas pa/ 'jigs pa dgra yi/ bral ba'i dpa' bo rgyal po/ yis// legs pa'i lam dge ba'i khrims/ gyi snang ba ston// 'jigs pa srid zhi'i/ bral ba'i dpa' bo yis/ legs pa'i lam thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i/ gyi snang ba ston// dang po gnyis 'dra/ phyi ma gnyis 'dra/ snying rje'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs mtshan dpe'i sku// snying rje'i bdag nyid mtshan pa'i sku/ mthong na sa dang po/ rab dga'i dpal yon sbyin// mthong na sems/ rab dga'i dpal yon sbyin/ dang po bzhi pa 'dra/ gnyis pa gsum pa 'dra ba/ 'dzad pa med pa'i zang zing*/ longs spyod ster// bsod nams ldan pa rgan po/ rnams kyi dpal// nor/ sngon bsags/ bsod nams ldan pa rnams kyi skyabs/ dpal// dam chos/ 'dzad pa med pa'i longs spyod ster// zang zing*/ tshig rkang gcig bzlas pa la/ dang po gnyis bzlas pa/ spobs pa'i gter brgyad grol bar mdzad/ (56)/spobs pa'i gter brgyad grol bar mdzad// 'jam pa'i dbyangs ni snying gi dbus// khyod ni gtsug gi rgyan du rol// dang po dang*/ gsum par bzlas pa/ yang gsang bla med man ngag snying thig bshad// klong chen pas ni rgya che mkhas pa'i lugs// yang gsang bla med man ngag snying thig bshad// khyod kyis zab pa ku sa li ltar ston//

dang po bzhi par bzlas pa/ bcos kun rdzob gtso bor/ min byang chub sems mchog skye// rgyal sras zhi ba'i lha las te// rgyal sras khyod la gsol btab na// don dam gtso bor bcos min byang chub sems mchog skye/ gnyis pa gsum par bzlas pa/ chos kyi rgyal po klong chen pa// rang phyi nang gi gzhan grub mtha'i pha rol son// rang gzhan grub mtha'i pha rol son// 'jigs pa bral ba khyod kyang ngo*// gnyis pa bzhi par bzlas pa/ paṇa chen bi ma mi tra yis// man ngag snying thig rtsal du bton// mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer stong 'bar bas// man ngag snying thig rtsal du bton// gsum pa bzhi par bzlas pa/ mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i dbang po dang*// rang byung rgyal ba khyod bsten na// rnying ma'i pha chos lag tu son// rnying ma'i pha chos (57)lag tu son// rkang pa dang po gnyis pa dang gsum par bzlas pa/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan mnga'// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan mnga'// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan mnga'// thub dbang mtsho skyes rje dang khyod// rkang pa dang po gsum pa bzhi par bzlas pa/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin sa mthor gshegs// khyod dang rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang*// spangs rtogs mthar phyin sa mthor gshegs// spangs rtogs mthar phyin sa mthor gshegs/ rkang pa gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi par bzlas pa/ khyod kyi dus gsum kun tu yang*// ma lus sems can don rnams sgrub// ma lus sems can don rnams sgrub// ma lus sems can don rnams sgrub// rkang pa bzhi ka mtshungs pa/ rig gdangs snang bzhi snang ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong*// rig gdangs snang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'phel// rig gdangs snang ba'i dkyil 'khor phebs// rig gdangs snang ba'i dkyil 'khor zad// tshig bcad gcig bzlas pas gnyis kyi don go ba/ skye rgu'i bdag po rtag tu zhi// rig byed bzhi yi lam kun kyang*// ma bslabs gzhan la ston nus zhing*// 'jig rten kun gyi gtsug na (58)mdzes//

de lan gnyis bzlas pas dpe tshangs pa la sbyar na/ 'dod gzugs bdag po'i ming ni rtag tu zhi// phyi rol pas 'dod rig byed bzhi yi lam// rang byung thugs la bkra ba gzhan la 'chad// 'dod khams gnas ris kun gyi steng na yod// dpe can 'jigs med gling pa la sbyar na/ skye rgu snying rjes bdag bzung khro ba med// sgra tshad gzo gso rig pa'i gnas kun kyang*// rang gis ma bslabs gzhan la 'chad nus zhing*// 'jig rten bsod nams can gyi bla mar 'os// bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rig yar myang 'das sgo/ pa'i rang snang rig pa'i mar 'khor ba'i sgo/ rang snang*// rig 'od ltar shar pa'i rang snang rig sku ltar shar pa'i rang snang*// rig ye shes ltar shar pa'i rang snang rig thugs rjes ltar shar pa'i rang snang*// rig gnyis maid ltar shar/ pa'i rang snang rig mtha' grol ltar shar ba ste lhun grub sgo brgyad do/ pa'i rang snang*// gnyis pa bsres pa'i zung ldan/ zab mo zab mo'i nang nas zab pa'i yang zab 'gran zla bral// zla bral theg dgu'i rtse mo theg mchog rgyal por rab grags pa// grags pa che ba'i che mchog lha dang bcas pa'i sa kun na// kun nas kun tu rab (59)bsgrags grags pa'i rnga sgra srid na snyan// rkang pa gcig bzlog pa/ dbang thob pa'i mkhyen pa mi zad pa/ gter blo mnga' ba'i ye shes kyi gzigs kun chos// rnams la'o/ gang la 'jug pa'i yul shes bya'i/ chos kun gzigs mnga' blo gter dbang// mkhyen pa med pa 'jigs ldan blo// blo ldan 'jigs pa med pa mkhyen// tshig bcad dang po bzlog pa/ rig 'dzin 'khrul zhig 'ga' yi blo// smra bsam brjod 'das chos kyi dbyings// med bzhin snang la snang bzhin stong*// stong bzhin zab la zab bzhin gsal// gsal bzhin zab la zab bzhin stong*// stong bzhin snang la snang bzhin med// dbyings kyi blo 'das brjod bsam smra// blo yi 'ga' zhig 'khrul 'dzin rig

/ tshig bcad phyed zlog pa/ dpa' mkhas rab zhi kun dga' mdzes// rgyal ba'i dga' ldan shes rab mchog / mchog rab shes ldan dga' ba'i rgyal// mdzes dga' kun zhi rab mkhas dpa'/ (60) ba lang gcin/ bod mkhas phyed 'khor// bod mkhas kun 'khor// bla ma'i kun 'khor// (61) khyaid kyi gsung dbyangs rna bar snyan zhing don rab gsal bas mtshan nyid theg pa gsal ba rab kyi mthar son pa yang khyed kyi snyan pa'i dbyangs las byung*// rjod byed snyan la brjod bya zab mo blo gros brtan pa'i 'jug ngogs dam pa rdo rje ltar brtan sngags kyi theg pa phyi rgyud sde gsum zab la snyan// rab tu zab pa'i snod dang ldan pa nyams len mtshar por 'jug par 'dod pas mtshar ba'i nyams len ma hā a nu zab mo rab kyi mthar thug pa// 'od gsal brtan thob ngo mtshar rmad byung nang gsal dbyings su snyom par zhugs nas phyi gsal 'pho chen ngo mtshar sku yis rtag cing brtan pa'i 'gro don gsal// (62)

dbyangs bzhi pa/ rnam dag lam bzang smra mkhas pa// zhi dbyings ji bzhin nyid gzigs phyir// ston mchog dngos byon mgon po mchog mkhyen brtse ye shes gter chen rje// gsum pa/ srid zhi gnyis kyi mig 'dzin cing*// mtha' yas dpal la mnga' mdzad pa// brgyud gsum tshul kun thugs su chud// lta ba rtag chad mtha' dang bral// gnyis pa/ mi shig yid kyi dbyig 'dzin cing*// rim gnyis khrid kyis srid 'di nyid// dge legs gter chen sa mchog brnyes te// bde legs dpe med de tshe skyes// dbyangs gcig pa/ yang dag lta ba mtha' dang bral// skal dman rnams la ma ltar byams// rnam dag sa lam mthar mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma pad+ma dbang*// skye gnas bzhi pa/ pad+ma spungs pa'i dpal gyi spor// kun mkhyen kun khyab kun tu bzang*// 'jigs pa'i 'jigs spang che ba'i mchog /rtag tu dad gdung ldan pas 'dud// gsum pa/ dpag med theg pa mtha' med pa// dpag par dka' ba mkhas pa'i thugs// de snyed de ni pha mtha' med// pha ma phal la 'bad med ston// gnyis pa/ dpa' bo dpal phun 'phel ba de/ (63)/'bad pas dbang po'i dpal der brten// thabs ldan thugs ni thub pa ste// lta ba dag pa thabs des ston// gcig pa/ pha ma phan bsam 'bral med pa// dpa' bo dpung pa'i dpal 'phel ba// ma pham dpa' bo bla ma'i blo// 'bral ba med par bsam par snyam// gsal byed bzhi pa/ legs la legs pa lam legs pa// bde nas bde ba'i lam de ni// bde ba'i dpal ni dpal du 'bar// legs pa'i lam der sbyor bar 'bad// gsum pa/ lung pa so sor// sems la sems pa// bsam pa la la// le los lus pa// gnyis pa/ la lung song la// sa sa sor sor// sems la sems la// legs lam la song*// gcig pa/ la lung logs la// legs lam la la// le lor lus las// las lam log la// sgra rgyan rnams so/ gsum pa gab tshig gi rgyan bcu drug las/ kun tu 'tshogs pa'i gab tshig rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyu rkyen dus sogs la sbyar ba/

kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyi// rigs skyes chos pa rgya yag grong*// de na tshod ma rnying pa dag bdag gir bzhes pa'i rnam thar las// (64) yang na/ e ma lha yi sa dag gi /legs bsam yas pa'i gnas kyi char// sngar zhig rang byung thol skyes su// rdo rje mtshan dang ldan pa byung*// bslu bya de gab tshig spyi bo'i rgyan gyur zla ba yang*// nyi ma'i 'od dang 'dres pa la// nam mkha' rnal mar 'byor ba yi// mdzes pa'i phul dang ldan pa byung*// rim pa bral ba/ tshogs pa las byung dkar dang dmar// rtse dga' lhan cig 'brug dang gnubs// ci dgar pha ma yang dang yang*// sbyor ba zhugs pa snyoms pa yin// yang na/ bde ba dga' ston dga' ba'i las// brtson pa'i sems la mngon par 'dod// shas cher dkar po bka' brgyud de// dmar po'i rigs ni snga 'gyur ba// rab bcom/ 'dab chags bgrang bya 'od dkar stag gis zos// sna tshogs shing rta bco brgyad mun bsal sngar// nyi mar 'chag dang zla bar mnal ba mo'i// mngal gyi sbubs grol bya rog rnam par gzhom// yang na/ stag gis zla ba ril po bzung*// nyi ma brgyad dang bcu shar sngar// nyi ldang zla nyal sbubs las smin// mun nag 'joms pa gtan bder 'gro// mthun gzugs/ yal 'dab ldan (65)pa'i 'khri shing gi /me tog 'dab yangs ge sar las// rdo rje 'od stong 'phro ba zhig /'jig rten mun pa sel phyir byon// rtsub mo/ drang srong blo dang ldan rnams kyi// gus dang ldan pas rab bskor nas// yon tan can zhes rgyags na yang*// de rnams da ni sprang po bzhin// grangs kyi gab/ dbyangs yig sngon 'gro gsal byed ni// phun sum tshogs pa lngas bskor ba// mtshan gyi sgra ldan skyes bu de// gangs can mkhas pa'i rgyan du byon// rab brtags/ rig byed gnas la mkhas pa dang*// gsung dbyangs yan lag du mar ldan// kun gyi gtsug na mngon mtho ba// gzigs par mdzod dang drang srong che//

ming du 'dus pa/ me tog las skyes 'bras bu ni// dang por rdo rje zhes su grags// dgra las rgyal bas rgyal po'ang 'di// so skye ma yin bem po min// bsgribs pa'i gab tshig mos dang bral ba btang byas nas// dga' ba rnams kyi bgrod pa gang*// sna tshogs 'phrul gyi 'jig rten 'gugs// gang de smad 'tshong ma yin no// mthun sgra/ me tog tshal min ming mthun gang*/(66)/rta mgrin ming can dag las rgyal// rang byung sprul sku 'jigs pa med// mtshan snyan gling bzhi'i khongs na grags// rmongs pa/ khye'u ma la rab khro bas// phyir zlog med pa'i gnas su song*// dga' bzhin pang du 'dzegs nas kyang*// phyogs gcig ma yin so sor blta// yongs 'phrog 'dzam gling shas gyur rgya dang 'gran// brlan 'joms grogs min gyis gdung rir// khri lde'i sras gcung bcu gsum bdag theg dgu 'dzin mdzad 'di na shar/ yang na klong chen rab 'byams kyis ye shes kyi skus rjes su 'dzin pa kho na brjod byar byas nas kun tshogs/ dri med 'od zer mkhar mthong bas// de tsam dga' ba ci la skye// dga' ba'i rgyu ni mtha' yas pas// des ko ci byed 'jigs med gling*// bslu byed/ mar me'i rgyal mtshan brten pa khyod// dga' ba ji ltar skye 'gyur ba// rab dga'i sa la co 'dri na// 'jig rten dga' bas de lta min// rim bral/ mthong byed sku yi ye shes dngos// rab 'byams klong chen mchog mkhas pa// gzhol ba'i sgrub pa mchims phu ru// mngon gyur gling (67)pa 'jigs med des// rab bcom/ lag zum mig rengs spu long rgyas// 'khyogs ldan ma yin mkhyen mkhyen sgrogs// po ta'-i dbang byin mkha' 'dra'i dgongs// nges rtogs des ni bya rog 'joms// mthun gzugs/ rkang pas btungs pa'i sa chu skyes des// zer stong 'phro ba'i nyin mor byed// mthong bas yal 'dab rab rgyas nas// sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston sbyin la ltos//

rtsub mo/ ri yi bu ni ri yi sul// g.yeng ba med par dal bar gnas// dmigs pa'i gza' gtad med pas na// de dag da ni smyon pa bzhin// grangs/ bod yig dbyangs gsum gsal byed bcus// yongs su rnam par brgyan pa des// rgyal ba dbyangs gnyis gsal byed ni// bcu gnyis mtshan ldan dngos su mthong*// rab brtags/ mgo bo dud cing mig dman pas// tshig gis gsol ba btab pa'i don// mngon par 'dod pas bdag la ni// rgyal po rjes su mi brtse'am// ming 'dus/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'ga'// dang po mar me rgyal mtshan grags// chos kyi rgyal po yang (68)ste 'di// bem po ma yin mi bdag min// sgrib pa/ dkar la mdzes pas blta na sdug tsha gdung sdug bsngal sel byed pa'i// bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas ku mud gnyen// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lags so// mthun sgra/ dbu yi rkang 'thung ming can ni// stong zil ming can dag las rgyal// mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor mthong ma thag / srid pa'i snang ba hrul hrul song*// rmongs pa'i/ klong chen pa ni sa gzhi la// khro bas ring bor thugs brtse bas// sa gzhi'i ngos su gzigs pa bzhin// nam mkha'i dkyil nas phyung ba bzhin// yongs 'phrog kha 'joms grogs min 'dzin pa'i gseb// bya rgyal zas gzhu bkra ba'i nang*// rgya mtshams bi ma dngos su byon// khri sras bcu dang gsum pas mthong*// gcig bsgribs/ mtshan dpe'i sku yi dkyil 'khor can// tshangs pa'i gsung gi sgra bsgrags pa// dngos po 'ga' las snang ba ni// bem shes min pa 'di ci zhig / gnyis sgribs/ mkha' dkyil dwangs par gzha' tshon dbus// mthong bas ngoms pa med pa de// gang gis mthong ma thag pa nas/ (69)/'od gsal dgongs pa 'pho 'gyur med// yongs 'dres la mang 'dus bslu byed bsres pa/ nam mkha' las snang 'od zer can// nyi zla ma yin rgyal po mchog / gdod ma'i mgon po mi yi tshul// 'dzin des rgyal tshab nyid du bkod//

le'u gsum pa'i snyan ngag gi skyon bcu'i dang po don nyams/ ri rab 'di ni dbus na gnas// rgya mtsho 'di yis mtha' nas bskor// chu klung gzhan rnams ca co sgrog// skya rengs 'di yis nyi ma khrid/ don 'gal/ 'dus byas dngos po thams cad kyang*// rtag par gyur pa ci yang med// gtso bo dbang phyug la sogs pa// mi rtag chos las 'das pa bden// skyon med/ ri dwags mig can lus skyes mda'// snying la zug na lha chos dang*// 'gal bar shes kyang dregs pa yis// gzhan dbang gyur la ci ste bsnyon// don gcig pa/ kun gsal 'chi med lha lam na// 'ja' 'od dbang po'i gzhu ris bkra// tsha zer nyin byed mkha'i nor bus// rkang 'thung me tog pad+ma rgyas/ skyon med/ dran pas dbang med yid 'phrog bla ma rje// dad na byin rlabs char 'bebs bla ma rje/ (70)/snying gi gdung ba rab 'phrog bla ma rje// thar pa'i lam sna 'dren mdzad bla ma rje/ the tshom can/ gnyis skyes mang po dag gis kyang*// rkang 'thung bkra ba'i skyed tshal du// 'dab ldan sna tshogs bzhad pa la// rgyang nas lag gis reg par byed// dmigs bsal sman par rtse 'jo'i tshig lus dang sems kyi nad gang yin// cha mi 'tshal bas bzhin bzang mnar// de bas lha rje khyod la ni// pho nya bdag gi re bas ci// rim pa nyams/ rgyal ba rnams kyi mkhyen rab dang*// snying rje'i mthu stobs kyi rang gzugs// gsang ba'i bdag po 'jam pa'i dbyangs// gru 'dzin bdag pos khyod la srungs// dmigs bsal/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnam pa bzhi// srid pa sgrub pa'i rgyu dang 'bras// gnyis kyi dang po zhi ba la// sbyor ba bzhi dang gsum pa yang*// sgra nyams/ chos kyi lugs la 'jig rten lugs// lugs de gnyis yin mkhas pas kyang*// 'jig rten mdzes pas nus min ni// spangs rtogs yon tan med pas so// skyon med/ /mkhas pa rnams las nyer brgyud pa'i// bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas rnams la// rnam mkhyen 'dod pas shes rab bskyed// de med 'bras (71)bu ci la 'byung*//

bcad mtshams nyams pa/ rgyal ba'i yab gcig gyur 'jam dbyangs// ngag gi dbang phyug smra ba'i seng*// mgon des bdag la gzhung lugs kun// phigs pa'i blo gros rno stsol cig / dmigs bsal/ rdo rje glu ma dbyangs lha mo// bai ta za byed nag mor bzhengs// khro bo shes rab 'od po che// dus dgra'i yum des shes rab stsol// mtshams sbyor nyams pa/ mi bdag rnam gnon khyod kyi rgyal// mtshan gyis khang bzang rtse nas mdzes// dgra sde gnon pa'i mthu dpung bdag /po khyod rtag tu rgyal gyur cig / sdeb sbyor chad lhag 'chi med zhi ba'i nags 'dabs su// dgra yi glag cor med pa dang*// skye bo'i rgyu 'grul dben pa der// bdag ni nam zhig 'gro bar 'gyur ram// mtshams sbyor bral ba/ nam mkha' ngos nyi ma zla ba// sa gzhi ngos rtsi shing lo 'dab// ngo mtshar ltad mo rnam mang po// bdag mig la ni snang bar gyur// bcu pa la nang gses drug gi yul 'gal ba/ 'brog pa'i sbra la btsugs pa'i skas// rong pa'i khang pa rgyangs ba'i khyon// byang thang yangs pa'i shing 'bras rnams/ (72)/mdun 'dir mchis so dga' ba la// dus 'gal/ dgun dus rtsi shing rgyas pa dang*// dbyar dus chu klung shel gos can// dpyid dus lo thog rnam par bkra// ston dus khu byug dang por phebs// sgyu rtsal dang 'gal ba/ dga' dang khro ba 'phel ba ni// dpa' ba dang ni snying rje'i nyams// skyugs dang dgod bro 'phel ba ni// rmad du byung dang 'jigs rung nyams// 'jig rten dang 'gal skyon/ sha sha rwa rnon sngo ba des// kun gsal khams kyi rkang 'thung za// dmus long mig gis de 'dra ba// lan gcig min par yang yang mthong*// nang pa'i rigs pa dang 'gal ba/ me yis tsha zhing bsreg pa bzhin// tha dad rgyu 'bras tshad ma zhes// tshad ma smra bas yang nas yang*// gsungs kyang mtshar sdug 'di la chags// phyi rol pa'i rigs pa dang 'gal pa/ drang srong rnams kyi sku nyid la// 'bras bu gnas par bzhed na yang*// zas kyi gseb na mi gtsang ba// ma mthong phyir na yid ma ches//

lung 'gal/ nges 'byung med kyang dge slong nyid// gzhan phan bral yang rgyal ba'i sras// ye shes ma rtogs sngags pa ni// yod de ser skya ston par 'dzin// de dag gi dmigs bsal yul/ (73)sangs rgyas gnyis pa mtsho skyes rjes// sgrub pa'i gnas su byin rlabs pa// bal yul yang le shod sogs su// dgun yang me tog pad+ma skye// dus/ sgrub pa'i mtshan rtags ngo mtshar ba// dgun dus sgra brgyas skad 'byin dang*// me tog sna tshogs rgyas pa dang*// ya mtshan dus la nges med 'byung*// sgyu rtsal/ na chung lang tsho gsar pas brgyan// gzugs dang kha dog ma rnying pa'i// ro dag dur khrod 'phangs pa la// 'dod ldan la la chags pas gzir// 'jig rten/ sol ba sa 'og btab pa las// 'bras bu 'byung ba mi srid mod// 'jigs med gling pas btab pa las// tshe ring ljongs kyi ljon shing skyes// rigs pa/ phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i dbus// dus gsum dus med dus kyi tshe// mi gsungs gsungs pa'i ston pa des// rgyu 'bras med pa'i chos 'khor bskor// lung*/ kun dkris can la bkag pa ni// 'ching ba med la de lta min// nyon mongs ye shes grogs su khyer// 'dod yon bde chen rgyan du che// sarga gsum pa'o/ /// 'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi 'jug ngogs che// snyan ngag (74)rin chen 'byung gnas gzhung bzang gi /tshig don nor bu'i rgyal mtshan legs par mchis// ded dpon pur+ṇā+e'i mtshan gyis bdag la byin// phyi nang gzhung rig kun la ma goms na// thams cad mkhyen pa thob par ga la 'gyur// gzhung lugs khyad gsod blun po'i lam bslab na// 'bras bu blun po thob par gdon mi za// de bas rgyu mtshan cung zad shes 'di yang*// lha gcig ngag gi dbang po'i drin las byung*// drin de shes nas drin ldan mchog de la// legs byas ci mchis mchod pa'i sprin du spro// mgon des tshe rabs kun tu rjes 'dzin zhing*// zab lam snying po snying thig dang 'grogs nas// kun mkhyen yab sras khyod kyi go 'phang nyid// dka' ba med par 'grub pa'i rgyu ru bsngo//
